config_B_top3.text: China, the largest borrower among LMICs, accounted for 30.0 percent of the group’s total debt service payments, and recorded a 13.7 percent increase to $419.8 billion in 2025.
When China is excluded, the cumulative external debt stock of MICs increased at a much faster pace—by 9.1 percent in 2025, to $6.9 trillion in 2025.

When the total prepaid or buyback amount of $34.5 billion in principal repayments is removed from these payments... the annual percentage increase persists but is reduced to a much smaller pace of 2.9 percent, to $328.6 billion, in 2025.
